notes:
What's new in 0.1.124:
- Windows app engine: updated Electron to 44.9.1 with a security fix for encrypted internet connections.
- Sign-in: the Windows server now supports the new Keep me signed in flow and tracks kept sign-ins through normal restarts. Changing a password, ending a session or changing the owner also ends the affected kept access. An owner notice explains when a remote sign-out still needs to finish.
- Audiobooks in the browser: a slower answer from an earlier search can no longer replace the results for the words you have just typed.
- Story Studio: a story whose saved starting page is missing opens at its first available page, including after Restart. A failed page-path check now shows an error instead of disappearing silently.
- Library and subtitles: browser library cards have names for screen readers, episode names lose release tags without losing real hyphenated names, shows named 1923 or 1883 keep their real names, and title-review rows show the current TV match. Subtitle files have better language names and forced or hearing-impaired flags, and capital italic, bold and underline tags keep their styling.
- Music: volume and mute carry over to the next song and next visit in the desktop and browser players. Desktop media keys can move to the next track, empty lyrics files no longer hide embedded lyrics, short crossfaded songs are counted, and extreme ReplayGain values no longer produce an invalid volume multiplier. German Music wording uses formal Sie.
- Live TV guide: invalid seconds in programme times are rejected, and the next programme can be found beyond a twelve-hour gap in the cached guide.
- Separate server change: a limit on share-code guesses went live on the Beebo server on Nov 16, 2026, 10:59 PM Eastern (47 of 47 server tests passed before and after the change). It is not part of this Windows installer, and no real household has tried it yet.
- Windows only. The phone app remains a separate release; the new Android Keep me signed in flow is not in the public phone app (1.72 build 144 or 1.73 build 145). New Live TV search is outside this release.
- Music analysis handles damaged audio samples without propagating invalid numbers.
- Photos Map limits the rows shown at once when map tiles fail, while keeping located photos reachable by scrolling and keyboard.
- Audiobook titles and series names taken from folders keep endings such as .22 or .sf instead of treating them as file extensions.
- Audiobook chapter parsing handles very large chapter times safely.
- Extremely large video chapter times no longer crash HLS playlist creation.
- Long radio metadata titles keep complete Unicode characters, including emoji, at the title limit.
- Automated checks: the full Windows desktop test suite ran on this exact source (20,849 passed, 0 failed, 84 not run, 35 to-do), two independent code reviews were clear, and the signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. No person has installed this version or tried its in-app update yet.
- Release source commit 7ac55ae68.
